verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document GPG or SSH commit signing or a 'verified' badge on commits. The 'SSH keys' docs entry is a bare title with no mention of signing. The DigiCert partner integration signs build artifacts in CI, not commits, and is a third-party feature, so it is adjacent at best. Commit signature verification is a fair axis for a Git hosting platform, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign commits with GPG or SSH keys and have them shown as verified
